# demo-typescript

A demo.

## Development

Install [pre-commit](https://pre-commit.com/#install), then the hooks:

```sh
pre-commit install
```

TypeScript uses [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/), which installs the Node.js and pnpm
versions pinned in `package.json`.
